title: Home and neighbours
why: Your building: the lift, the cellar, the keys, and the neighbours you meet on the stairs.

bridge.title: Building manners

rows.note: Czechs greet everyone in the lift and on the stairs
on signs and shouted on stairs

bridge.note: Saying 'Dobrý den' to every neighbour, even strangers, is the normal Czech habit. It costs two words and earns a lot.

dialog.en: Excuse me, where is the cellar?

pattern.en: Up or down? Ask it in the lift.

silly.en: A bear lives in our lift.

silly.cz: Klíč je ve sklepě. A medvěd taky.
silly.en: The key is in the cellar. And the bear too.

postcard.title: Off to the chata
postcard.text: Many Czech families have a weekend cottage, a chata or chalupa. On Friday afternoons the roads out of town fill up.
